name: gizza-ai/basic-auth-header-generator
summary: Build an HTTP Basic Authorization header.

tool.description: Build an HTTP Basic Authorization header value from a username and password: 'Basic ' + base64(username:password) per RFC 7617. Set full_header=true to get the whole 'Authorization: Basic …' line. The username must not contain a colon; the password may be empty.

username.description: The username (must not contain a colon).

full_header.description: When true, return the full 'Authorization: Basic …' header line; otherwise just the 'Basic …' value. Default false.
